title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy ’82 show with smoking Shakedown Street and a historic first Touch of Grey, but hampered by mostly audience‑type recording quality and noticeable hiss/patches.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its relentless energy, standout jams on Shakedown Street, Stella Blue, Saint of Circumstance and the debut of Touch of Grey, with Jerry’s guitar work described as smooth and sometimes “going nuts.”  Recording-wise the tape is largely an audience capture with several AUD patches and a hiss‑filled mid‑set; occasional soundboard bits improve bass presence but overall clarity suffers.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the musical performance highly (4–5 stars) while rating the audio lower (2–3 stars). The weighted blend yields a solid overall score despite mixed technical feedback.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Predominantly audience tape with noticeable hiss and occasional AUD patches (e.g., Playin' → Crazy Fingers). A few soundboard sections improve bass balance, but overall the mix is muddy and lacks crispness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is described as a powerhouse that felt like a second‑set, with nonstop playing and tight transitions; the second set contains high‑octane jams (NFA, Stella Blue) though some listeners felt it lost momentum toward the end.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry’s smooth guitar tone and moments where he “goes nuts,” especially on Saint of Circumstance; his nonstop playing is highlighted as a show‑stealer.
band_member_comments.Phil: A few comments mention the ability to hear Phil’s bass better in soundboard patches, but no specific praise or criticism beyond that.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir is noted for swearing during Saint of Circumstance and delivering strong vocal/riff work throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brief nod to “Bobby” (Brent Mydland) on keyboards during the Lost > Saint segment, but otherwise no detailed keyboard commentary.
